tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mahā kā la'i bstod pa bstan srung dgyes pa'i lha'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī ma hā kā la ya/ hūm̐/ rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yab gyur rdo rje 'chang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir srin po khros pa'i skur/ /nyer bstan srung ma'i dbang po kun gyi gtso/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can khyod la bstod par gyi/ /gang sku baiḍūr+ya yi lhun po la/ /tsha zer chu 'dzin gyis dben byugs 'dra'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag gis/ /nye bar mdzes pa khyod la bstod par bgyi/ /bstan la gnod byed dgra bgegs tshogs rnams kyis/ /bde skyong sha chen dwangs ma 'gems mdzad pa'i/ /rnam sprul gser las legs grub ghan+ḍe mchog /thugs kar bzung ba khyod la bstod par bgyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi/ /mi mgo skam pos dbu skyes mtshams mdzes shing / /mgo rlon khrag 'dzag rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i/ /do shal byas pa khyod la bstod par bgyi/ /lto 'gro dbang po rigs bzhis phyag sogs mdzes/ /dung chen phreng ba'i drwa ba drwa phyed kyis/ /dbu mgul gsus khyim phyag zhabs tshogs rnams brgyan/ /stag lpags sham thabs gsol khyod bstod par bgyi/ /dbang zhu'i mdangs can lha gos lhab lhub kyis/ /dpung-stag g.yas g.yon ngos nas thur du 'phyangs/ /'dam skyes tsha zer bcas pa'i lte ba'i steng / /dam nyams dbugs bral gdan bzhugs bstod par bgyi/ /rab 'bar 'jigs rung drag po'i me 'bar dbus/ /bzhugs pa'i bstan srung dbang po khyod bstod mthus/ /gdug can bstan 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa dang / /rnal 'byor ci bsam don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /dpal ldan mgon po sogs/ ༈ bh+yoḥ grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo u ma yi/ /sras mo'i tshul bzung dpal ldan nam gru ma/ /rgyal bstan skyong mdzad nag phyogs 'joms pa'i dpal/ /nag mo 'jigs rung khyod la bstod par bgyi/ /dgra bgegs snying khrag 'khyil ba'i rgya mtsho'i dbus/

/rlung gi shugs ldan mgrin bzang gwa dmar steng / /dam nyams zhing chen g.yang gzhi'i zar gyis mdzes/ /srin po'i gdong gi sga bstad bstod par bgyi/ /zhon pa'i gong smed brang 'gro'i phreng bas brgyan/ /snga sha nad rkyal phyi sha tshon grus mdzes/ /sho rde'u dkar nag la sogs drag mo yi/ /cha lugs yongs su rdzogs khyod bstod par bgyi/ /char sprin mun nag 'thibs 'dra'i mdangs ldan sku/ /zhal phyag sku lus tshogs rnams shin tu rid/ /khro 'khrugs rngams pa'i zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum g.yo/ /nad kyi bdag mo khyod la bstod par bgyi/ /g.yas kyi dang pos srin ral 'bar ba bsnams/ /'og ma dam nyams klad khrag thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi dang pos mdung rnon rting rtsar bzung / /'og mas ba dan 'dzin khyod bstod par bgyi/ /dbu gtsug mgrin sngon mjug sgro'i gdugs lding zhing / /thod skam lnga yi dbu brgyan snyan gnyis la/ /brang 'gro gdong lngas legs spras glang lpags gsol/ /re lde ba glang ko gyon bstod par bgyi/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag sogs/ ༈ hūm̐/ log 'dren gdug pa'i bsam pa nyer 'chang rnams/ /ming gi lhag mar mdzad phyir rgyal kun gyi/ /mthu stobs nus tshogs gcig bsdus ma rung skur/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal khyod la bstod par bgyi/ /'dam skyes rta ljang mi ro'i gdan stengs su/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa/ /zhabs zung brkyang bskum 'gyings bag gar dgu'i nyams/ /rnam par g.yo ba khyod la bstod par bgyi/ /rtsa zhal mig sman mdog can mi ro gsol/ /g.yas zhal zla ba zil gnon khro zhing 'dzum/ /g.yon zhal pad+ma rā gar rgya cher bzhad/ /steng zhal dung mdog rab khros bstod par bgyi/ /g.yas g.yon phyag bzhis gri gug thod khrag dang / /ral gri mdung rnon gdengs pas dgra la 'phyar/ /phyag 'gag rus phreng gis mdzes mchan khung drwa/ /gser bum bdud rtsis gang thogs bstod par bgyi/

/thod skam dbu brgyan mgo rlon do shal byas/ /sbrul nag tshangs skud phreng ba mchod phyir thogs/ /dril bu g.yer kha'i sil sil du mas spras/ /stag lpags sham thabs gsol la bstod par bgyi/ /g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab ngos nas mchongs rgyug pa'i/ /g.yung mo gtum mo sring mo sing ga lī/ /sku mdog dmar nag ser ljang gri thod 'dzin/ /rgyu ma'i ga shal can rnams bstod par bgyi/ /yab yum 'khor bcas dmar nag me 'bar dbus/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol zhing rnal 'byor skyong / /hūm̐ phaṭa k+ṣiṃ gi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog /rig 'dzin dgra lha 'khor bcas bstod par bgyi/ /zhing skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams sogs/ zhes pa 'di ni sa skya pa kun blos zhabs drung thams cad mkhyen pa sa skya pa'i yab chos chos srung gur zhal gnyis kyi nang nas mgon po zhal gyi chos skor zhus pa'i skabs zhig rmi lam du rje bla ma dang mjal zhing dges pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma zhig mdzad pa'i ngang nas chos srung che chung gnyis la bstod pa sh+lau ka bdun pa de brtsam zhes gsungs par rmis pa'i rgyu mtshan zhabs drung du phul bar gtang rag cig dang bstod pa zhig brtsoms dgos pa'i brdar 'dug ces bka' stsal bar brten mi phyed dad pa chen pos kun nas bslangs te sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gso 'dzin pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis pa'o/ /smras pa/ rang la nyams rtogs yon tan med gyur kyang / /bla ma'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis 'tsho ba'i/ /bstan srung kun gyis bu gcig bzhin du skyong / /e ma ngo mtshar 'di 'dra gsar du shar/ /ma dpe ltar zhus dag par bkra shis so// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ mahākāla'i bstod pa bstan srung dgyes pa'i lha'i rol mo/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
